camel_example: aliyun pairecservice PUT /api/v1/experimentgroups/3 --region cn-hangzhou --header "Content-Type=application/json" --body '{"Description":"This is a test.","LayerId":"3","InstanceId":"pairec-cn-abcdefg1234","Name":"experiment_group1"}' --version 2022-12-13 --force
description_en: Updates the information of a specified experiment group, such as the name and description
description_zh: 更新指定实验组的信息，例如更新实验组的名称、描述
kebab_example: aliyun pairecservice update-experiment-group --experiment-group-id 3 --layer-id 3 --name experiment_group1 --description 'This is a test.' --instance-id pairec-cn-abcdefg1234 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateExperimentGroup

parameters.help_en: The ID of the experiment group. You can call the ListExperimentGroups operation to obtain the ID
parameters.help_zh: 实验组ID，可通过接口ListExperimentGroups获取
parameters.name: experiment_group_id

parameters.help_en: The configuration of the experiment group
parameters.name: config

parameters.help_en: The ID of the specified crowd for crowd targeting. You can call the ListCrowds operation to obtain the ID
parameters.help_zh: 人群定向的指定人群ID，可通过接口ListCrowds获取
parameters.name: crowd_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of traffic targeting for the experiment group. Valid values:
All: All traffic.
Filter: Traffic that uses filter conditions.
CrowdId: Traffic specified by a crowd ID.
Random: Random traffic based on a percentage
parameters.help_zh:
实验组流量定向的类型，可能的取值包括：
All  所有的流量
Filter 使用过滤条件的流量
CrowdId 通过指定人群ID
Random 按照百分比随机流量
parameters.name: crowd_target_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the debug crowd. You can call the ListCrowds operation to obtain the ID
parameters.help_zh: 调试人群ID，可通过接口ListCrowds获取
parameters.name: debug_crowd_id

parameters.help_en: The debug users. The value must be the UID of an Alibaba Cloud account or RAM user. Separate multiple UIDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 调试用户（需为阿里云账户主账号/子账号uid），多个用户需通过逗号作间隔
parameters.name: debug_users

parameters.help_en: The description of the experiment group
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The time period for traffic distribution
parameters.name: distribution_time_duration

parameters.help_en:
The traffic distribution method. Valid values:
● UserId: User ID.
● TimeDuration: Time period
parameters.help_zh:
分流方式。
● UserId-用户ID
● TimeDuration-时段
parameters.name: distribution_type

parameters.help_en: The filter conditions specified for crowd targeting
parameters.help_zh: 人群定向指定的过滤条件
parameters.name: filter

parameters.help_en: Instance ID of the instance. You can call the ListInstances operation to obtain instance ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the layer. You can call the ListLayers operation to obtain the ID
parameters.name: layer_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the experiment group
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether an AA experiment group is required
parameters.name: need_aa

parameters.help_en: The percentage of random traffic used to match the experiment group when the traffic targeting type is set to Random. Valid values: 0 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 当实验组流量定向的类型是Random时，使用随机流量匹配这个实验组，可能的取值范围是 0 - 100
parameters.name: random_flow
